description: Drives a real Android device over ADB and attaches the resulting screen to every action.
name: io.github.edgecasehuman/droidsight

environmentVariables.description: The only Android target the process may use. Required when ADB reports more than one authorized device; the server refuses to guess.
environmentVariables.name: DROIDSIGHT_DEVICE_SERIAL

environmentVariables.description: Explicit path to the ADB executable. Falls back to ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, ANDROID_HOME, then PATH.
environmentVariables.name: DROIDSIGHT_ADB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Confines host paths used by APK installation and file push/pull. Defaults to the process working directory.
environmentVariables.name: DROIDSIGHT_LOCAL_ROOT

environmentVariables.description: Numeric PIN for UI actions that require automatic unlock.
environmentVariables.name: DROIDSIGHT_DEVICE_PIN

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to publish the arbitrary shell and macro tools. Grants authority equivalent to broad ADB shell access.
environmentVariables.name: DROIDSIGHT_ALLOW_SHELL

environmentVariables.description: Path to a persistent debug log. File logging is otherwise disabled.
environmentVariables.name: DROIDSIGHT_DEBUG_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Tracing filter. Defaults to warn, or debug when a debug log path is set.
environmentVariables.name: DROIDSIGHT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to start the long-running device event monitor. Requires DROIDSIGHT_DEVICE_SERIAL.
environmentVariables.name: DROIDSIGHT_EVENTS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to start the background enforcement loop. It re-applies watched device state on a timer, including unlocking the screen. Off by default.
environmentVariables.name: DROIDSIGHT_SENTINEL

title: droidsight
